title: Goat Sensor Lab clinical-outcomes-v1.csv contract
description: Append-only clinical outcome provenance linked to a pre-specified prediction window. This artifact is separate from observable behavior and welfare label heads.

columns.name: outcome_id
columns.description: Globally unique immutable outcome record ID.

columns.name: record_pseudonym
columns.description: Pseudonymous clinical record key; identifying records remain in the approved clinical system.

columns.name: reference_standard_id
columns.description: Pre-registered clinical definition, assay, examination, or adjudication standard.

columns.name: reference_standard_result
columns.description: Result encoded according to the referenced standard; not a free-form sensor inference.

columns.name: clinical_outcome_code
columns.description: Outcome code defined in the registered clinical protocol.

columns.name: clinical_onset_epoch_ms
columns.description: Best-supported clinical onset time, blank when not established.

columns.name: assessment_monotonic_ns
columns.description: Session monotonic assessment time when recorded during a sensor session.

columns.name: prediction_window_definition_id
columns.description: Versioned, pre-specified window rule from the registered analysis plan.

columns.name: blinding_deviation
columns.description: Required explanation when the assessor was not blinded.

columns.name: source_record_sha256
columns.description: Digest of the access-controlled source record or approved extract.

row_rules: Clinical outcomes are assigned only through the registered reference standard by a qualified assessor; the IMU model never assigns them.
Prediction window boundaries and definition are frozen in the analysis plan before outcome unblinding.
prediction_window_end_monotonic_ns must be greater than prediction_window_start_monotonic_ns and must not use post-outcome information unless the registered endpoint explicitly permits it.
Never modify or delete a published row; corrections append a new outcome_id and supersede the prior record.
Direct identifiers, narrative clinical records, and access-control credentials must not be exported in this table.
